limitations: Composite visual reference state; publication dates do not establish a common capture date.
Frontage dimensions other than the separately documented Glico panel are approximate photo fits. Source building vertices and roofs are unchanged.
B034 upper and lower fronts follow different source envelopes; the photographs do not resolve the source model’s stepped geometry into an exact curved facade.

Lettering and graphic panels are original simplified illustrations of inspected signage, not pixel-accurate advertising reproductions or a current campaign inventory. S14 dairy/Kaigen imagery and S6 Asahi/Glico imagery are interpreted; unobserved rear facades remain generated.
Warm/cool window occupancy, light intensities, water glimmer and representative visitor routes are authored presentation choices.
The boat, source buildings and mapped river retain the earlier geometry and source limitations.
S15 supports local food-service character only. B037/B041 food uses and B049 cafe tenancy remain unverified. Noren, lantern profiles, menus, merchandise and fittings are representative.

S16 supports B046 restaurant identity and first-floor dining/tank features, not exact bay dimensions, floor plans or the tank visibility from the west window. Its river and west fronts have windows only; no public entrance is asserted.

B046/B049 north forecourts fill the display gap to the modeled upper walk. Source clipping prevents water/walk/building overlap, but the 1.95 m level and patch widths are interpretations, not resolved local terrain measurements.

The complete ground-floor context layer records geometric coverage, not additional photo coverage or verified tenancies. Source floor levels and diagrammatic terrain remain subject to the existing datum limits.

Distinct bay compositions are illustrative design identities, not additional verified merchants. B039 remains neutral commercial frontage; its former unverified sweets-shop assignment is removed. Known corner hosts share finishes and artwork; multiple windows can belong to one store.

redistribution: Photographs remain outside the repository. Runtime and Blender pack only repository-authored geometry, original canvas sign art, and the existing open source geometry derivatives.

runtimeRegistration.method: Original photo hints are retained above. Runtime detail is aligned to a matching continuous source wall with at most 14.4 cm fitting thickness. Approximate joins require a shared source edge; nearby parallel setback walls stay separate. The fitted plane clears the source vertices. Source shapes are unchanged; Donki follows the separately recorded composition translation.
runtimeRegistration.ownership: One facade owner per reference wall, including the finished complement of all registered rectangles. No generic QR skin at corners or between photo panels. Patches follow source triangles and discard Float32-collapsed faces. B034 closed ribs and glazing follow its original sloped east setback. B046-south owns its source-fitted street elevation; B049 reserves only its 3.1 m ground-floor band. B037-east reserves only its upper sign/glazing band, starting at 5.25 m, and preserves the existing source-floor shops beneath it.

runtimeRegistration.glico: The separately verified 10.38 x 20 m panel retains its dimensions; the frame has a small intentional overhang beyond the source wall.

contextGroundFloor.fitting: Full 3.1 m wall support for rectangular fittings; clipped panels/ribs on partial walls. Context relief <= 0.62 m and <= 42% of sampled available clearance. Doors require modeled ground within 0.16 m of the source floor.
contextGroundFloor.retention: All 58 selected bodies retained. 56 have eligible exposed fronts; B005 and B054 are enclosed at ground level. Donki has six separately directed display/entrance bays.
contextGroundFloor.artwork: Private shared 2048x1536 storefront atlas: 48 cells, four coordinated treatments, portable outlines. Information icons avoid labeling display-only windows as entrances.

riverbankSigns.morph: All seven restored panels carry their complete textured surfaces and cabinet geometry through QR turns, reversals and content edits.
riverbankSigns.rendering: Art clips to individual atlas cells; cabinets fit the actual source walls with separated edge rails. Five private textures total remain retained.

lettering.runtime: Forty-nine fitted label outlines, including clock numerals; no host-font dependency or runtime network request. Typeface outlines are not exact brand lettering.

glicoAnimation.behavior: Track/rainbow illustrations and coordinated reflected light share the existing activity clock. The current atlas blend, cabinet and reflected colors freeze into the QR transformation. Still-photo motifs are reference-directed; timing and light response are authored. The editable review captures the current time-zero geometry.

waterMotion.behavior: Source-contained reflection drift and spreading stern crests share the existing activity clock. Current geometry and composited colors join the QR turn and freeze across reversals/content edits. The current static-review counts are recorded in the waterfront review manifest.

presentationLighting.evidence: Authored emphasis using the existing inspected photographs and approved Osaka roles; not surveyed photometry.
presentationLighting.massings: building/roof = mix(navy, highRise, 0.18/0.22); retain muted Donki finish and warm narrow wheel accents.
presentationLighting.spill: Existing seven sign light fields use 0.43 strength and vertical falloff coefficient 14 in normalized tile coordinates; reflections use 9 m decay.
presentationLighting.glow: A tight low-strength bright-pixel screen composite behind sharp source artwork on the existing presentation canvas. No additional WebGL pass or render target.
presentationLighting.transition: Glow fades over 8–65% progress. River-led warmWindow pulse belongs to the moving surfaces. Exact QR inks remain unchanged.
presentationLighting.transparent: Bypass presentation glow; retain original source alpha.
